algorithm_note: Same DFS/backtracking contact-search architecture as the baseline, but the experimental implementation uses analytic 3-DOF leg IK, progress pruning after contact switches, expanded touchdown fallback, and modified search parameters.
visualization_note: Display-only interpolation uses touchdown-before-liftoff ordering: pre-switch -> touchdown approach -> dual support -> support transfer -> liftoff. Interpolated frames are not continuous-trajectory certification.
validation_boundary: Level-1 kinematic/contact result only; no dynamics, force/friction, impact, finite-thickness collision, or continuous-time hardware certification.
